export_evidence: Company site (ttspl.in) states: "TTL is a non-vessel operating common carrier engaged in the freight forwarding business. Its main business activities are consolidation of export cargo, de-consolidation of import cargo, full container loads, and air freight from India to destinations around the world" (Screener.in company profile, sourced from company disclosures). No bill-of-lading record with date, destination and HS code was retrievable: importkey.com/countries/india/total-transport-systems-limited returned only a paywalled shell ("Loading...", "Sign up for a free trial today") with 0 shipment rows visible; volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403. Source counter: 5 shipment-data sources attempted, 0 rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: Listed on NSE (NSE: TOTAL), Screener.in consolidated P&L: "Sales 622" (FY Mar 2026, Rs crore), "TTM 788", quarterly "Sales 283.89" (Sep 2026) — i.e. real, audited domestic operating turnover of roughly Rs 620-790 crore, not a claim. Screener peer table also records "Total Transport 19,901 FCL / Ocean Freight Volume · Mar 2026 Source", confirming actual cargo volume handled. Company site lists pan-India offices, CFS operations and 489 employees. GSTIN-level turnover band not public in retrieved sources — null.
note: Company is a listed NVOCC/freight forwarder and liner agent (incorporated 1994, Mumbai, 7th floor T Square, Sakinaka, Andheri East), not a manufacturer or goods exporter: it consolidates and forwards OTHER companies' export cargo, so it has no own export shipments under its own name and no B/L of its own to cite. Declared HS 320890 (paints/varnishes) does not match its actual activity (freight forwarding / logistics services, SAC-type service export, not a goods HS chapter) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to its factual service classification. Domestic supply activity is confirmed by audited listed turnover (Rs 622 cr FY2026, Rs 788 cr TTM) and 19,901 FCL ocean freight volume, so this is not a 'no supply traces' case. Export-side shipment-level proof (dated B/L, destination, HS) could not be obtained from any free source — treat as declared, not confirmed. Revenue: Rs 622 cr FY2026 consolidated (Screener.in). Export volume split: null (not public in retrieved sources).
